sharedRules.name: Well Supported
sharedRules.description: Each Primary Unit in this Force may have two Support units. The number of actions in the Support units may not exceed the standard number of actions for a Support unit.

sharedRules.name: Ace Gunner
sharedRules.description: This model may Snap Fire with any weapon that is in an Arc facing the target.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Control Systems
sharedRules.description: +1 Action.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Neural Net [ANN]
sharedRules.description: When choosing a posture, select one Skill rating. Improve that Skill rating by 1 for the duration of the models activation.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Weapons
sharedRules.description: Reduce the Threat point Value of Models with a Unit Availability of ST or HV that are equipped with an Advanced Category weapon by 1TV.

sharedRules.name: Agile
sharedRules.description: Attacks targeting this model will miss on a Margin of Success of zero (MOS:0) or less. A Braced model loses the benefit of Agile.

sharedRules.name: Air Mobile
sharedRules.description: All models in the Force are upgraded with the Airdrop trait for +0TV.

sharedRules.name: Airdrop
sharedRules.description: This model may deploy using the Reserve rules.

sharedRules.name: Allies
sharedRules.description: The army may include units with from another Faction Model List.

sharedRules.name: Ammunition Variants:X [Ammo:X]
sharedRules.description: A weapon with two or more Ammo:X traits must select one of the Ammo:X traits to apply to each attack where X is the associated trait that applies to the attack. Non-Ammo:X traits on the same weapon apply to all attacks regardless of the Ammo:X trait selected.

sharedRules.name: Amphibious [Amphib]
sharedRules.description: This model is not destroyed by entering water terrain that is greater than half its height. This model may move in water at its slowest speed movement type and does not count water as Difficult terrain. While in water terrain that is greater than half its height an Amphibious model has Light Cover. Hover vehicles may not claim cover from water terrain.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Air [AA]
sharedRules.description: This weapon resolves attack rolls against Flying models using the firing model’s normal Gunnery skill instead of a 6+. Do not add the additional 12” of range when firing at a model using an Air Strike action. This model may Snap Fire at models using the Flying movement type to cross the battlefield.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Air Weapons
sharedRules.description: This model may attach the Anti-Air [AA] trait to one Autocannon [*AC], Rotary Autocannon [*RC], Anti-Tank Missile [*ATM], or Laser Cannon [*LC] weapon. An upgraded Missile category weapon becomes a SAM Missile of the same rating.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Infantry [AI]
sharedRules.description: This weapon may do more than one damage per attack against models with the Infantry type.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Missile System [AMS]
sharedRules.description: This model gains a free Reroll when attacked by weapons using the Indirect or Missile categories. Friendly Models within 6” of this model also gain this Reroll.

sharedRules.name: Anti-Structure [AS]
sharedRules.description: Double the Margin of Success of an attack when resolving damage against Terrain, Structures, or Fortifications.

sharedRules.name: Area Effect X" [AE:X"]
sharedRules.description:
Models within X inches of a target Primary model or point are Secondary targets. (See 10.2). AE
attacks ignore ECM Defence.

sharedRules.name: Armor Piercing:X [AP:X]
sharedRules.description: A Target with an Armor Rating higher than the Penetration Rating of the attack will suffer damage equal to the Margin of Success up to the rating of the trait, or normal damage, whichever is greater. Area Effect attacks with the AP trait only resolve the AP trait against primary targets. AP attacks can damage infantry, the AP trait itself has no effect on infantry models.

sharedRules.name: Armored Personnel Carrier:X [APC:X]
sharedRules.description:
This model may transport up to X Infantry Squad Models. Two Teams or Drones may be Transported
in place of one Infantry Squad.

sharedRules.name: Armories
sharedRules.description: Reduce the cost of grenades and shaped explosives by 1TV.

sharedRules.name: Arms
sharedRules.description: This model can use a weapon with the Arm Arc to Snap Fire. This model may purchase Grenades, Shaped Charges, and Panzerfausts upgrades. This model may climb vertical terrain without requiring the Climbing trait.

sharedRules.name: Attached:X
sharedRules.description: The model name X is attached to this model. Do not count the Actions of any attached models when creating units.

sharedRules.name: Autocom:X
sharedRules.description: The range for models to be in Formation with this model is X”.

sharedRules.name: Automatic Fire System [Auto]
sharedRules.description:
The weapon system this trait is attached to may snap fire without spending an action. The
attack resolves with its Gunnery skill degraded by 1.

sharedRules.name: Autopilot
sharedRules.description: When this model uses the Standby action it gains one additional standby token.

sharedRules.name: Basilisk Upgrade
sharedRules.description: Any model from the South Model List with a Unit Availability of GP, SK, or FS may be upgraded with the Basilisk trait for +0TV. Models with the Basilisk trait have +1” Movement Rating, and have the Sensors:18” trait when braced.

sharedRules.name: Best of the Best
sharedRules.description: Add 1 additional Command Point to the Commanding Officer.

sharedRules.name: Blast
sharedRules.description: Attacks with Blast ignore the effect of the Agile trait and ECM Defense modifiers. The cover modifier against blast attacks for Secondary targets is determined from the target model or point.

sharedRules.name: Brawler:X
sharedRules.description: Add the rating as a modifier to any Melee attack or Melee defense rolls this model makes with a target in an Arc with a melee category weapon. A model with multiple instances of the Brawler trait adds them all together for the total modifier.

sharedRules.name: Burst:X
sharedRules.description: Add a +XD6 modifier to any attack roll made with this weapon.

sharedRules.name: Climbing Equipment [Climber]
sharedRules.description: Allows a model to scale vertical terrain easily. Note that climbing equipment can take the forms of grappling hooks, climbing claws, spike guns, etc., and is not specific to a particular kind of equipment.

sharedRules.name: Combat Medic [Medic]
sharedRules.description: This model removes two intensity from Fire or Corrosion tokens when it uses a Damage Control Action targeting a model with the Infantry type. Medics may not be commanders.

sharedRules.name: Combined Arms Specialists
sharedRules.description: If the Force has at least three different types of model on the battlefield at the start of a round then the Commanding Officer gains +1 Command Point.

sharedRules.name: Commander
sharedRules.description: A Commander is a model that is selected to be a leader of a Force of models or a Combat Group of models. Commanders take initiative tests, give orders, and distribute command point Rerolls.

sharedRules.name: Comms:X
sharedRules.description: This model may use the Comms:X trait to count as X Comms rolls successes. If passive ECM reduces the Comms:X trait to zero, this model must roll Comms as normal but may only count successes up to the rating of the trait. This model may Relay.

sharedRules.name: Conscript
sharedRules.description: This model may not be purchased for a unit as a commander. If out of formation, this model degrades all its skills by 1 (GUN:4+ becomes GUN:5+).

sharedRules.name: Conscripts (Upgrade)
sharedRules.description: Add the Conscript trait to all non-commander and non-duelist models in the Force. Reduce the Threat point Value of all models with the conscript trait by -1TV per action.

sharedRules.name: Corrosion Resistance [Resist:C]
sharedRules.description: This model degrades the Target Number of Corrosion Marginal hit rolls to 5+.

sharedRules.name: Corrosion:X
sharedRules.description:
A target hit with a Corrosion effect resolves normal damage then rolls a number of D6 equal to the Margin of Success of the attack plus the rating of the effect. For each dice that equals or exceeds a target number of 4+, 1 damage will be caused. In addition a Corrosion token will be placed on the model.

A model without the Recovery or Medic traits must use a damage control action and succeed a roll with BD:1 and a target number of 6+ to successfully use a damage control action on itself, or another friendly model to remove a corrosion token. Standard modifiers apply to this roll (See 2.2). Due to specialized equipment, a model with the Recovery Vehicle trait can remove a corrosion token with an action without requiring a roll.

In each Cleanup phase, any model with a Corrosion token rolls 1D6 and suffers 1 damage on a roll of 4+. If not removed by a Damage Control action, a Corrosion token will persist on the model until the game ends or the model is destroyed. A model with a Corrosion token that is hit by another attack with Corrosion will roll the immediate special damage roll for the attack but will not place another Corrosion token. A model can only have one Corrosion token at a time.

After applying Corrosion special effects on Infantry models do not place a token.

sharedRules.name: Counter-Battery Sensors [CBS]
sharedRules.description: This model, and any friendly models in Formation with it, may Snap Fire in response to an enemy Indirect attack. A Snap Fire reaction using CBS may select an Indirect Category weapon to Snap Fire with and counts as having Forward Observed the target. Only terrain that overlaps the target model will provide a cover modifier against CBS Snap Fire attacks.

sharedRules.name: Dancer
sharedRules.description: Add the Agile trait; requires a PI:4+ or better.

sharedRules.name: Defender
sharedRules.description: Add the AMS trait; requires a weapon with the Burst trait.

sharedRules.name: Drone Bay:X
sharedRules.description: This model may Purchase X Drones from the Generic Upgrades list without counting towards the maximum, or minimum, number of actions in a unit. This model may transport any attached Drones (not N-KIDU drones).

sharedRules.name: E-War Specialist
sharedRules.description: Add +2D6 to any EW rolls made by this model.

sharedRules.name: Electronic Counter Measures:X [ECM:X]
sharedRules.description: A model with this trait reduces the Comms:X rating of enemy models within Sensor range by the ECM Trait rating. A model with ECM may use any Electronic Warfare actions noted as ECM actions.

sharedRules.name: Electronic Counter-Counter Measures
sharedRules.description: Models with ECCM may Reroll Comms rolls and EW rolls. A model with ECCM may take passive EW rolls for any friendly models within 6” that are targeted by an enemy EW action. Requires Lock to active model.

sharedRules.name: Elite Force
sharedRules.description: The CTF must use the Elite army option. The CTF may not select units with a Unit Availability of GP.

sharedRules.name: Family Connections
sharedRules.description: The Commanding Officers (CO) unit must be upgraded to a Veteran unit and all models must purchase the Veteran Upgrade if they do not already have it.

sharedRules.name: Family Ties
sharedRules.description: Choose one Generic Veteran Upgrade. Any Commander in the Force may Purchase the Veterans trait for +1TV without counting towards the 0-1 limit of veteran units. Veteran Commanders may purchase the chosen Generic Veteran Upgrade for +1TV.

sharedRules.name: Fast Cavalry
sharedRules.description: Sampson models gain the Agile trait for 0TV.

sharedRules.name: Field Armor
sharedRules.description: This model suffers one less damage from each damaging attack to a minimum of one damage.

sharedRules.name: Fire Resistance [Resist:F]
sharedRules.description: This model degrades the Target Number of Fire Marginal hit rolls to 5+

sharedRules.name: Fire:X
sharedRules.description:
A target hit with an attack with the Fire trait resolves normal damage, then rolls a number of D6 equal to the rating of the trait. For each die that equals or exceeds a target number of 4+, one damage will be caused. After this roll there is no further effect, fire suppression systems control the fire.

Example: A Light Flamer (LFL) attack hits a target with AR:5 with a MOS:3. A LFL has a PEN:3 and a the Fire:2 trait. and does one normal damage. The player then rolls dice equal to the rating of the flamer and adds one damage per roll of 4+.

sharedRules.name: Flak
sharedRules.description: Weapons with Flak add a +2D6 modifier to attacks targeting Flying models.

sharedRules.name: Fragmentation [Frag]
sharedRules.description: Weapon with Frag add a +2D6 modifier to attack rolls targeting Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Guided
sharedRules.description: A Guided weapon that attacks a target that has been Forward Observed with a Target Designator may benefit from the Target Designator:X (TD:X) rating modifier, and does not suffer the range modifiers for attacking using the Indirect Category.

sharedRules.name: Gunslinger
sharedRules.description: Add the Link and Range: 3-9/18” traits to one Autocannon, Frag Cannon, or Grenade Launcher.

sharedRules.name: Hackers
sharedRules.description: A model in this Force using an ECM Sensor Jamming action or reaction improves its Electronic Warfare (EW) skill rating by 1.

sharedRules.name: Haywire
sharedRules.description:
A model that hits a Target with a weapon with the Haywire trait resolves normal damage then rolls 1D6, a roll of 4+ causes one additional damage. Place a Haywire token on the target model. A model with a haywire token counts as a Crippled model. Remove the haywire token in the cleanup phase. Haywire may not be removed by a damage control reaction.

Note: The Crippled modifier is only applied once per roll, regardless of the number of sources.

sharedRules.name: Haywire Resistance [Resist:H]
sharedRules.description: This model is not affected by Haywire and does not suffer any marginal damage rolls from a Haywire weapon attack, though it does take normal damage.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Gear Carrier:X [HGC:X]
sharedRules.description: This model may transport X models with the Type: Gear or Type: Infantry Squad. Two Infantry Teams or Drones may be transported instead of one Squad.

sharedRules.name: High Tech
sharedRules.description: Each unit must include at least two actions of models with at least one Advanced or Missile category weapon.

sharedRules.name: Hovertank Commander
sharedRules.description: The commanding officer of a PAK force must select a Vehicle type model.

sharedRules.name: Initiative:X [Init:X]
sharedRules.description: Add XD6 to any initiative test that this model makes.

sharedRules.name: Inspirational
sharedRules.description: Commanders that damage an enemy model with a Fighting Staff melee attack may give a Skill point to any other friendly model within 6”.

sharedRules.name: Jetpack:X"
sharedRules.description: This model may use its Jetpack to make a Powered Boost move instead of a normal Move. A Powered Boost move may only turn once at the start of the move and does not use any movement type advantages or disadvantages. The model may move forwards or backwards in a straight line with both a horizontal and vertical distance equal to the Jetpack trait rating and may not interrupt this move to use an action. Any terrain less than the vertical maximum of the jump rating is ignored and no dangerous terrain tests are made for terrain that the model power boosts over.

sharedRules.name: Jump Jets:X
sharedRules.description: When this model Moves it may displace vertically up to the rating of the trait each time it encounters terrain up X Height or less. This model may not end its movement on terrain that is too narrow to contain its base.

sharedRules.name: Lead by Example
sharedRules.description: Whenever a Duelist damages an enemy model immediately add one Skill Point to any other friendly model with Sensor Lock to the damaged model. This Skill Point does not refresh in the Cleanup phase. If another opposing Duelist is present, the Lead by Example bonus can only be gained from damage done to the opposing Duelist until that model is destroyed. These bonus Skill Points represent the inspiring influence that a Duelist can have on friendly models.

sharedRules.name: Leaders
sharedRules.description: All Southern commanders gain the Init:1 trait or improve their Initiative trait rating by 1. All commanders gain the Reach:1” trait on their VB melee weapon if they have one.

sharedRules.name: Licensed Fabrication
sharedRules.description: The army may include Sidewinders, and Ferrets from the North and South Model Lists in any NuCoal unit with a matching Unit Availability.

sharedRules.name: Limited Ammunition:X [LA:X]
sharedRules.description:
This weapon may Attack a number of times equal to the X rating. Mark this model with a token
to indicate ammunition remaining.

sharedRules.name: Limited Availability:X [Limited:X]
sharedRules.description: This model may only be included in units that share the UA of X. “X” may be either a standard UA or a unique UA of the limited unit. Models with Multiple UAs listed with their Limited trait must select one listed UA to apply when constructing a Force. Example: A model has UA: GP(0+), IN and the Trait Limited:MI, IN. This model may only be included in GP units that either have the Limited:MI trait or in units that have the UA:IN.

sharedRules.name: Linked Weapon [Link]
sharedRules.description: Attacks with this weapon improve the attack skill rating of the active model by 1.

sharedRules.name: Lone Wolf
sharedRules.description: Duelists may not use Rerolls from Command Points, or Orders. Note: This rule does not affect duelist models from the KADA Sub-list.

sharedRules.name: Low Profile
sharedRules.description: This models silhouette is always 1⁄2 the Height indicated. When Activating, this model may choose to use its regular Height when choosing posture. A model with a standby token may choose to use its full height when it uses the standby token to take an action.

sharedRules.name: Lumbering
sharedRules.description: This model may only turn once per Move.

sharedRules.name: Melee Specialist
sharedRules.description: Add the Brawler:2 trait or increase an existing Brawler trait by 2.

sharedRules.name: Mount
sharedRules.description: This model does not have a rear arc. Its front arc extends 360 degrees around the model. Unless noted otherwise, all weapons on a model with Mount have the Fast Turret arc.

sharedRules.name: Multi-Component Vehicle [MCV]
sharedRules.description: This model has one or more additional components attached to it. Each component is a separate target.

sharedRules.name: N-KIDU Command Matrix:X" [NCM:X"]
sharedRules.description: Conscript N-KIDU models within X” of this model count as In Formation with a commander.

sharedRules.name: Observers
sharedRules.description: Allied support units may not use Command points from NuCoal models. South Support units may be given any General upgrades except CMD model upgrades and may be veterans without counting towards the total number of veteran units in the force.

sharedRules.name: Offroad:X
sharedRules.description: This model adds +X” to the distance it may move in difficult terrain. This does not apply to water features.

sharedRules.name: Open Topped [Open]
sharedRules.description: Transported models may fire their weapons while transported by this model. The transported model must use the same posture as the transporting model. If the Open trait has an attached arc indicated then the models may only fire in that arc.

sharedRules.name: Pathfinders
sharedRules.description: Any Gear unit may use the Pathfinders Reserve deployment option.

sharedRules.name: Penetration:X [Pen:X]
sharedRules.description: This weapon has a Penetration rating of X instead of the normal listed Penetration rating.

sharedRules.name: Pintle Mounted Weapon [Pintle]
sharedRules.description: A transported infantry unit may fire a Pintle mounted weapon as an attack action.

sharedRules.name: Police State (Peace River)
sharedRules.description: One Peace River GP, SK, or FS unit may be upgraded to Military Police for +0TV. Models lose all RP weapons and gain the Shield:1 trait.

sharedRules.name: Police State (South)
sharedRules.description: One General Purpose (GP) unit composed of models with the Limited:MP trait may be upgraded to veteran for 1TV per model, in addition to the normal single Veteran unit choice.

sharedRules.name: Political Appointees
sharedRules.description: Add an Executive Officer (XO) or a Second in Command (2iC) to each unit for 1TV.

sharedRules.name: Port Arthur GREL Allies
sharedRules.description: Any NuCoal Sub-List can include Support units with the Unit Availability of IN from the CEF Model List. Any NuCoal unit with a Unit availability of HV may select LHT-67 and LHT-71 models from the CEF Model List. LHT-67 and LHT-71 models selected this way may replace their LC, PA, or RL weapon with a MRC for +0TV.

sharedRules.name: Precise
sharedRules.description: Hits with a margin of zero (MOS:0) ignore the Agile trait. Note: This weapon may be used to target very small models like Demo or Recon drones.

sharedRules.name: Prospectors
sharedRules.description: Any walker model may add the Climber trait for +1TV.

sharedRules.name: Proximity:X
sharedRules.description: Weapons with this trait have an Area Effect that is centered on the attacking model. Do not resolve the attack against the firing model. All targets of an Area Effect attack with Proximity are Primary Targets.

sharedRules.name: Quickdraw
sharedRules.description: Add the Auto trait to one weapon with the Arm Arc.

sharedRules.name: Range X-Y/Z"
sharedRules.description: Replace the normal range of this weapon type with the range indicated in the rating of the trait.

sharedRules.name: Reach:X
sharedRules.description: This melee weapon has a range of 0-X / X”.

sharedRules.name: Recon
sharedRules.description: This model may deploy using the Recon Special Deployment options.

sharedRules.name: Recovery Vehicle [Recovery]
sharedRules.description: This model removes two intensity from Fire or Corrosion tokens when it uses a Damage Control Action (See 9.6b) targeting a non-infantry model. Recovery Vehicles may not be Commanders.

sharedRules.name: Sabre
sharedRules.description: Add the Reach:1” trait to any Vibro Blade or Combat Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Satellite Uplink:X+ [SatUp:X+]
sharedRules.description: This model may use actions and abilities noted as requiring a SatUp:X trait (See 14.0). This model may Relay.

sharedRules.name: Second Line
sharedRules.description: This army may not use the Elite force option.

sharedRules.name: Secure Zone
sharedRules.description: Gain 5% of the Force Threat point Value as free points that may only be used towards purchasing Generic Support Options.

sharedRules.name: Sensor Boom
sharedRules.description: This model may extend its silhouette by 1” in any direction when making an attack action for purposes of Lock and Sensor Lock.

sharedRules.name: Sensors:X
sharedRules.description: This model’s Sensor range is X. This model may use the Sensor Boost action.

sharedRules.name: Shield/Paired Weapon
sharedRules.description: Add a Shield:1 trait, or add the Link trait to a melee weapon.

sharedRules.name: Shield:X
sharedRules.description: This model gains a +XD6 modifier to defense from attacks from the front. Attacks that ignore cover ignore this bonus. AE attacks with the primary target in this models front arc do allow the modifier.

sharedRules.name: Silenced [Silent]
sharedRules.description: Attack actions with this weapon do not remove a Hiding token, or cause a model to lose its Stealth trait bonus to defense.

sharedRules.name: Smoke:X
sharedRules.description: Combat or Braced posture models with Smoke:X may use an Action to fire Smoke. Firing Smoke places a AE:3” centered on the location of the Active model. Smoke is Light Area Cover and has a height of 4”. Each Smoke trait can be used X times per game. Remove Smoke Area Effects in the Cleanup Phase.

sharedRules.name: South Allies
sharedRules.description: Any NuCoal unit with a Unit Availability of HV may select Hetaroi models from the South Models List.

sharedRules.name: Special Issue
sharedRules.description: Any unit Commander (even Allied units) may have 0-1 Greyhound.

sharedRules.name: Specialized Training
sharedRules.description: Any combat group that contains only one model type (Gear, Infantry, Vehicle, etc) gains 1 additional Command Point for the unit Commander.

sharedRules.name: Split Fire:X [Split:X]
sharedRules.description: This weapon may split attacks between X targets.

sharedRules.name: Spray
sharedRules.description: Attacks with this weapon ignore cover modifiers for partial and area terrain and the Agile trait. Attacks with Spray ignore ECM Defence.

sharedRules.name: Stabilizer
sharedRules.description: This weapon may only be fired if the model is Braced.

sharedRules.name: Stable Weapons Platform [Stable]
sharedRules.description: This model adds a +1D6 modifier to all Gunnery rolls.

sharedRules.name: Stealth
sharedRules.description: This model improves its Piloting Skill by 1 for Defense Rolls against Direct and Indirect attacks targeting the model if the model has adjacent and intervening cover. This modifier does not apply when the model is using an attack action or reaction, active sensors, an EW action, or making a Comms roll. This modifier does not apply if the model is attacked with a melee attack, or has no cover from the Observer of a Forward Observation (See 14.3). Sensor Lock against a model with the Stealth trait has a -6” modifier to the range of the Sensors.

sharedRules.name: Stripped Down
sharedRules.description: Any model with a Unit Availability of GP or RC may upgraded with the Stripped Down trait for 0TV. Any model with this trait adds 2” to its Movement Rating but has -1 Hull Rating and +1 Structure rating. Example: A Stripped Down Hunter would have H/S:3/3 instead of 4/2.

sharedRules.name: Support
sharedRules.description: This model may only be selected as part of a Support Unit.

sharedRules.name: Target Designator:X [TD:X]
sharedRules.description: Target Designator: A TD may only be used at Combat or Braced speeds and only if the target model does not have Full Cover. A Forward Observation by a model using a Target Designator trait may use the TD trait to activate the Guided trait on weapons chained to the Forward Observation. The TD trait adds a +XD6 modifier to a Guided attack. A Target Designator allows the target the terrain Cover modifier it would have against a direct attack from the observing model.

sharedRules.name: Team Play
sharedRules.description: Primary units may only consist of models with two or more actions.

sharedRules.name: Test Pilots
sharedRules.description: In addition to normal Veteran upgrade options, each unit, including Support units, may upgrade one model with the Veteran upgrade. These models may select upgrades from the Generic and Veteran Upgrades list.

sharedRules.name: Tested in Battle
sharedRules.description: One Gear or Strider model in each unit may be upgraded to a Veteran for +1TV. This does not count towards the 0-1 limit of veteran units.

sharedRules.name: The Best Money Can Buy [UMF]
sharedRules.description: The Force Commanding Officer gains the Init:1 trait, or adds 1 to an existing Init:X trait. Models with the UA limit of CMD cost -1TV.

sharedRules.name: Towed
sharedRules.description: One model with this trait may be transported by a vehicle with the APC trait without using the transport capacity of the towing vehicle. After movement is completed this model is placed within 1” of the rear of the vehicle and may be attacked as a separate target. A Towed model must still disembark from the transport in order to fire. A towed model may not change elevation in a building and must be deployed on the lowest floor.

sharedRules.name: Transition Forces
sharedRules.description: HAPF units may mix models from the South and NuCoal Force lists if their Unit Availability Attribute matches the Unit Availability of the unit. Only models which are allowed by the “Allies: South” rule may be included.

sharedRules.name: Transport:X/Y
sharedRules.description: This model may transport X models of the Y model type.

sharedRules.name: Veteran [Vet]
sharedRules.description: This model is a veteran and has one skill point. This model may purchase upgrades from the Veteran upgrade list.

sharedRules.name: Vulnerable to Corrosion: [Vuln:C]
sharedRules.description: This model suffers Corrosion Marginal damage on a target number of 3+.

sharedRules.name: Vulnerable to Fire: [Vuln:F]
sharedRules.description: This model suffers Fire Marginal damage on a target number of 3+.

sharedRules.name: Vulnerable to Haywire: [Vuln:H]
sharedRules.description: This model suffers one additional Marginal hit when hit by a weapon with Haywire.

sharedRules.name: Walk or Fly
sharedRules.description: Primary units may not include vehicles with only the ground movement type.

sharedRules.name: Well Equipped
sharedRules.description: Support units may purchase Generic Upgrades.

sharedRules.name: Older Equipment (North)
sharedRules.description: Primary units may not include Jaguars, Cheetahs, Grizzlies, Kodiaks, or Scimitars.

rules.name: Elite Army Option
rules.description: All Primary and Support unit models in an Elite Force require the Veteran Trait. Support units may purchase Generic Upgrades. An Elite army may not purchase any Support Options other than Air Support.

rules.name: Local Production
rules.description: Primary units may not include Cheetah, Cheetah Paratroopers, or Black Cat models. Tigers, Assault Tigers, and Destroyer Tigers gain the Unit Availability of FS. Weasels gain the Unit Availability of SK.

rules.name: Anti-Air Upgrade
rules.description: This model may attach the Anti-Air [AA] trait to one Autocannon [*AC], Rotary Autocannon [*RC], Anti-Tank Missile [*ATM], or Laser Cannon [*LC] weapon. An upgraded Missile category weapon becomes a SAM Missile of the same rating.

rules.name: Drones
rules.description: A Gear or Vehicle model with a Drone gains the Drone Bay:1 trait.

rules.name: Smoke
rules.description: This model gains the Smoke:2(Aux) trait.
